grammar_focus: 间接引语(直接引语转间接,KS15)主考——ask if / whether(一般疑问)、ask + 疑问词 when/why(特殊疑问,用陈述语序)、say/tell + that(陈述句)+ 时态后移(will→would / have→had)+ ask sb to do / refuse to do / be allowed to do(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院时,他问医生手术是否成功,但医生拒绝告诉他。第二天,这位病人要了一部床头电话。趁房里只剩他一人时,他挂通医院的电话交换台,要求与米灵顿医生讲话。当医生接过电话,吉尔伯特先生说他想打听一位名叫约翰·吉尔伯特的病人的情况;他问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功,医生说很成功。然后他又问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以回家,医生说他还得在医院再住两个星期。之后,米灵顿医生问打电话的人是否是病人的亲属。“不是,”病人回答说,“我就是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。”

grammar_card.title: 间接引语:把别人的话转述出来
grammar_card.intro: 把直接引语(引号里的话)转述出来:陈述句用 say/tell + that;一般疑问用 ask if/whether;特殊疑问用 ask + 疑问词。转述时时态往后退(will→would,have→had),语序变成陈述语序。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: He said that he was tired.
She asked if you were tired.
'When will Jack arrive?' 特殊疑问
Tom asked when Jack would arrive.
She asked if you had been abroad.
he would go home / it had been successful

specialRules.rule: 转述疑问句要用陈述语序(动词跟在主语后),不再倒装:asked when Jack would arrive(不是 would Jack)。
ask sb to do 请某人做;refuse to do 拒绝做;be allowed to do 被允许做。
specialRules.mark: ask sb to do / be allowed to

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone Dr. Millington?
options: To find out if his own operation had been successful
To ask for a different doctor

passage: While John Gilbert was in the hospital, he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful, but the doctor refused to do so. The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone. When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington. When the doctor answered the phone, Mr. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr. John Gilbert. He asked if Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful, and the doctor told him that it had been. He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home, and the doctor told him that he would have to stay in the hospital for another two weeks. Then Dr. Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient. 'No,' the patient answered, 'I am Mr. John Gilbert.'
